evaluation.price_profit: decimal odds gross return including initial stake; lose -1 unit; win odds-1 units
evaluation.primary: market-calibrated Brier vs market-and-player Brier; report all markets whether positive or negative
evaluation.selection_test: >=70pct probability AND >=3pct paper expected value at recorded decimal odds; no in-test threshold adjustment

known_limitations: Prior July grades were inspected in earlier research; not pristine unseen holdout
Selections chosen deterministically from external source and not contemporaneously published Zenith picks
Quoted sportsbook prices not guaranteed to be executable; third-party commercial rights unverified

predictors.market_and_player_last5: ridge logistic intercept + logit(p_no_vig) + direction-scaled last-five strictly-prior completed game stat vs line

test_only: 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-05, official analytic grades where publisher grade absent
train_only: 2026-06-18 and earlier, vendor grades cross-verified official MLB
